summary: Czech founder-led shop, 30 staff, 2-5 M EUR; our ~EUR 93k is ~2-5 % of its turnover and it says it is reviewing small accounts. Sole source of adapter piece HI (15.88). Owner prices from a two-year-old spreadsheet and asked where our index figures come from; he expects partnership for holding prices in 2022. Open moderately, bring sourced index data and the amber scorecard, offer volume; it may concede on facts it did not know.
notes: Needs volume and recognition of the 2022 favour; says it is reviewing small accounts. Its spreadsheet is two years old, so current index data may be news to it. Quality amber all year (OTD 73-85 %, ppm ~1,500-1,900, 21 complaints). We pay 5.4 days late on average without written complaint.

evidence.quote: he works from his own spreadsheet, last updated two years ago.
in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.
they are reviewing small accounts and will focus on customers with volume.
avg 5.4 days late, 51.5 % of invoices over 5 days late

arguments: index change with named sources (only drivers that fell)
contract §3.1: no increase notice by 2 Oct
tactics: Acknowledge the 2022 favour, then give index figures with their source; it asked where we get them.
Use the scorecard once as the quality argument.
Offer a binding volume to counter the small-account review.
Push steadily but stop short of a walk on a sole-source part.
playbook.expected_concession: History mixed: 2024 asked +5.8 % settled +2.7 %, 2025 asked +2.8 % settled 0 %; average kept share of ask 0.59.
